# FreeCMO

> Open-source SMB CMO Agent Harness: Composer -> Orchestrator -> Ephemeral Subtask Micro-Pipeline.

## Canonical Rules & Guides
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Orchestrator cross-channel rules, strategy lock, and 4-lens reviewer
- [guardrails.yaml](./.agents/guardrails.yaml): Autonomy envelope, stop-losses, VIP exclusions
- [HARNESS_SETUP.md](./docs/HARNESS_SETUP.md): Setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Antigravity, Cursor, Codex, Local LLMs & OpenRouter

## Canonical Skills
- [ad-creative-angle-matrix](./skills/social/ad-creative-angle-matrix/SKILL.md): Build visual-dna timed storyboards (0-4s/4-10s/CTA) and falsifiable ad angles from winners.
- [aeo-entity-readiness](./skills/search-organic/aeo-entity-readiness/SKILL.md): Score 10-prompt AI citation share, entity gaps, and answer-first page priorities for GEO/AEO.
- [blended-mer-reconciler](./skills/analytics/blended-mer-reconciler/SKILL.md): Reconcile blended MER, separate branded vs non-branded ROAS, and evaluate stop-loss triggers.
- [churn-winback-engine](./skills/lifecycle-cro/churn-winback-engine/SKILL.md): Diagnose logo churn, NRR, J-curve ad-scaling cash troughs, and margin-safe winback sequences.
- [cmo-init](./skills/core/cmo-init/SKILL.md): Initialize brand-truth.md and visual-dna.json from URL or repo with draft_pending_review lock.
- [comms-press-release-writer](./skills/content-comms/comms-press-release-writer/SKILL.md): Draft AP-style press releases, launch announcements, media pitches, and incident comms grounded in verified facts.
- [community-pain-radar](./skills/social/community-pain-radar/SKILL.md): Mine Reddit, HN, and forums in FTS5 radar.db for pain clusters with mandatory FTC disclosures.
- [competitor-battlecard-pricing](./skills/core/competitor-battlecard-pricing/SKILL.md): Build factual competitor comparison battlecards and calculate promo/discount gross-margin break-even lift.
- [creator-affiliate-partnerships](./skills/lifecycle-cro/creator-affiliate-partnerships/SKILL.md): Cap creator flat fees and affiliate commissions within allowable CAC, draft UGC briefs, and enforce FTC
- [display-native-ad-studio](./skills/social/display-native-ad-studio/SKILL.md): Guide image creation, photo/UI acquisition, IAB sizing, and copywriting for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Display & Native ads.
- [editorial-blog-linkedin-writer](./skills/content-comms/editorial-blog-linkedin-writer/SKILL.md): Write answer-first SEO/GEO web blog posts, Reddit/HN forum posts, and LinkedIn articles or carousels.
- [email-deliverability-flows](./skills/lifecycle-cro/email-deliverability-flows/SKILL.md): Audit SPF/DKIM/DMARC sender health, retention flow ROI, and VIP relationship exclusions.
- [google-ads-smb-audit](./skills/search-paid/google-ads-smb-audit/SKILL.md): Audit SMB Google Ads campaigns for budget floors, conversion volume, and auto-apply traps.
- [gsc-query-drift-triage](./skills/search-organic/gsc-query-drift-triage/SKILL.md): Triage Google Search Console query impression/position drift and paid-SEO cannibalization.
- [landing-page-cro-audit](./skills/lifecycle-cro/landing-page-cro-audit/SKILL.md): Audit landing page speed, above-the-fold CTA clarity, offer friction, and A/B test power.
- [launch-campaign-playbook](./skills/core/launch-campaign-playbook/SKILL.md): Orchestrate T-21 to T+7 product, seasonal, and promo launches with pacing and margin circuit breakers.
- [local-seo-gbp-optimizer](./skills/search-organic/local-seo-gbp-optimizer/SKILL.md): Optimize Google Business Profile categories, LocalBusiness schema, and review velocity.
- [meta-ads-smb-audit](./skills/social/meta-ads-smb-audit/SKILL.md): Audit Meta Ads spend floors, Advantage+ defaults, CAPI deduplication, and 14-day stop-losses.
- [offline-local-channels](./skills/social/offline-local-channels/SKILL.md): Plan & write currency-aware WhatsApp broadcasts, GSM-7 SMS, community FM radio spots, flyers, and bulletin boards for low-connectivity & 7B-local workflows.
- [review-referral-flywheel](./skills/lifecycle-cro/review-referral-flywheel/SKILL.md): Engineer compliant customer review velocity and CAC-capped double-sided referral loops.
- [search-term-negative-miner](./skills/search-paid/search-term-negative-miner/SKILL.md): Mine Google Ads search term reports via n-gram clustering to cut zero-conversion waste spend.
- [seo-geo-code-pr](./skills/search-organic/seo-geo-code-pr/SKILL.md): Stage isolated git branch PRs adding canonicals, meta tags, FAQPage JSON-LD, and AI robots.txt.
- [social-seo-repurposer](./skills/social/social-seo-repurposer/SKILL.md): Turn /cmo run-with-this assets into Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, TikTok/Shorts & Reddit social SEO drafts.
- [tracking-health-audit](./skills/analytics/tracking-health-audit/SKILL.md): Verify GA4, pixel, server-side conversion integrity, site speed, and budget gate prerequisites.
- [unit-economics-floors](./skills/core/unit-economics-floors/SKILL.md): Compute allowable CAC, break-even ROAS, payback months, and cohort LTV floors before spend.
- [weekly-cmo-brief](./skills/core/weekly-cmo-brief/SKILL.md): Synthesize weekly shift ledger, stop-losses, and cohort reallocations into max 5 Composer decisions.

## Full Skill Catalog Metadata

### ad-creative-angle-matrix (social / tier 1)

- Calculators: experiment_math
- Description: Build visual-dna timed storyboards (0-4s/4-10s/CTA) and falsifiable ad angles from winners.
